rules.name: mandatory fields present
rules.description: transaction_id, store_id, sale_date, product_name, quantity, unit_price must be non-empty.

rules.name: transaction_id unique
rules.description: Terminal batch re-sends: first copy promoted, repeats quarantined.

rules.name: sale_date parseable and plausible
rules.description: After remediating DD/MM/YYYY, anything still unparseable or out of range is rejected.

rules.name: quantity integer between 1 and 50
rules.description: Returns are a separate feed; zero/negative or bulk quantities are suspicious.

rules.name: unit_price between 0.01 and 5000
rules.description: Catches placeholder 0.00 prices and decimal-shift errors.

rules.name: region/category/payment in reference domains
rules.description: Curated aggregates group by these columns, so unknown values must not leak in.

rules.name: cust_num well-formed
rules.description: Non-walk-in customer numbers must be 6 digits.

rules.name: cust_num exists in customer master
rules.description: Orphaned customer: revenue is real so the sale is promoted, flagged for steward follow-up.
